structured.answer: I'd pick the second one, "ב. אותו סיפור בשורות". Each line has the words and the amount together on the right, so I read it like a bank statement and don't have to look up and down. Either way, what I take from it is the same: wait until year 6, because the employer adds a lot ("+54,000") and the tax ("−13,974") disappears.
